Editor notes from [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]], 15 October 2026. Mini article for the ''Magic'' designer because Braunlich and Tesh met him while designing the [[Star Trek CCG]], and he later designed Wizards' ''[[Star Wars Trading Card Game]]''.

* Bainbridge Island meeting has no calendar date in Braunlich's Booster Pack #27 or Radio Free Decipher 14; it is the ''Star Trek'' CCG design period (1993–1994).
